control_objectives.name: Research integrity
control_objectives.description: Keep formal claims, citations, evidence capture, and reproducibility gates auditable before delivery.

control_objectives.name: Environment stability
control_objectives.description: Keep skills, profiles, schemas, MCP configuration, HELM snapshots, and VELA handoff contracts consistent.

control_objectives.name: Adaptive learning
control_objectives.description: Admit durable lessons through a controlled retrospective loop instead of silent route or skill mutation.

controlled_variables.name: Route selection
controlled_variables.description: The route chosen by research-autopilot for each task type and project scope, with user confirmation before a new route or chain is entered.

controlled_variables.name: Skill and memory placement
controlled_variables.description: The placement of durable logic, reusable procedures, long-form interpretation, and transient facts.

controlled_variables.name: Contract validity
controlled_variables.description: Schema-valid catalogs, dispatch artifacts, validator envelopes, and snapshot boundaries.

controlled_variables.name: Research stage progression
controlled_variables.description: The confirmed transition from one research milestone to the next, including literature acquisition, structured reading, PDF evidence annotation, drafting, figures, review, revision, polishing, language review, and formatting.

controlled_variables.name: External adoption pressure
controlled_variables.description: The inflow of GitHub patterns, plugins, MCP servers, skills, and harness ideas.

feedback_signals.name: Validator feedback
feedback_signals.description: Structured pass, needs_review, or fail results from envctl and legacy validators.

feedback_signals.name: Project retrospective feedback
feedback_signals.description: Project-end friction, repeated prompts, missing routing logic, and proposed skill changes.

feedback_signals.name: Knowledge feedback
feedback_signals.description: Zotero verification, Obsidian sync packages, and writing-reference capture records.

feedback_signals.name: Daily audit feedback
feedback_signals.description: Proposal-only reports from the cybernetics daily skill audit automation.

controllers.name: Research Autopilot
controllers.description: Sole total router for research tasks, profile choice, helper skills, and route cards.

controllers.name: Research Stack Manager
controllers.description: Governance controller for skills, plugins, MCP servers, reports, and recurring update proposals.

controllers.name: Environment Control CLI
controllers.description: Typed command and validator layer used by local operators and HELM.

controllers.name: Project Retrospective Evolver
controllers.description: Adaptive controller that decides whether a project produces no change, skill update, new skill, or routing fix.

actuators.name: Skills
actuators.description: Reusable procedural behavior and domain workflows.

actuators.name: Schemas and catalogs
actuators.description: Typed contracts for routing, project initialization, handoffs, validation, and control logic.

actuators.name: Codex automations
actuators.description: Recurring proposal-only checks before any autonomous mutation is approved.

actuators.name: HELM app
actuators.description: Default management surface that invokes envctl and consumes snapshots without becoming the source of truth.

disturbance_classes.name: Path drift
disturbance_classes.description: Old local roots, stale plugin cache paths, and mismatched runtime cwd values.

disturbance_classes.name: Upstream change
disturbance_classes.description: New plugin, MCP, GitHub, or Codex native feature updates that may tempt uncontrolled adoption.

disturbance_classes.name: Citation noise
disturbance_classes.description: Unverified references, fabricated DOI values, missing DOI-waiver evidence, and discovery results incorrectly promoted into formal bibliography.

disturbance_classes.name: Context loss
disturbance_classes.description: Thread compaction, missing handoff, project memory drift, or repeated reconstruction of the same workflow.

stability_metrics.name: Validator pass rate
stability_metrics.description: All required validators pass before commits, HELM snapshots, or autonomous evolution.

stability_metrics.name: Memory placement precision
stability_metrics.description: Durable logic goes to the kernel, procedures go to skills, long explanation goes to Obsidian, and noisy specifics are discarded.

stability_metrics.name: External adoption discipline
stability_metrics.description: Every upstream component has keep, adapt, watch, or reject status before any implementation.

adaptation_rules.trigger: A completed project exposes repeated friction, missing routing logic, or repeated manual reconstruction.
adaptation_rules.rollback: Keep the prior skill or route in git history and reject the evolution event if validators fail.

adaptation_rules.trigger: A GitHub repository, plugin, MCP server, or workflow pattern is proposed for local adoption.
adaptation_rules.rollback: Remove the candidate from active adoption and keep only a watch record.

adaptation_rules.trigger: Daily cybernetics audit proposes a low-risk environment correction.
adaptation_rules.rollback: Revert the dedicated branch before promotion; never mutate runtime config silently.
